descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Consultanță și servicii de afaceri
As a Billing Specialist, you will navigate the intricate terrain of our billing processes. Your responsibilities will include generating claims, resolving billing inquiries, and delivering exceptional customer support. This role specifically caters to the medical insurance sector, serving customers located in the United States of America.
 Contract Type: Undetermined period
 Type of Work: Full time
 Location: On-site
 Work Schedule: Monday to Thursday: 15:00 – 00:00, Friday: 16:00 – 22:00
 Salary Range: 3000 – 4000 RON net monthly, based on skills and experience
 Main responsibilities: 
gathering billing data from our system and generating claims
addressing billing inquiries through various channels such as calls, emails, and SMS
investigating bill discrepancies, conducting thorough analyses to identify root causes and implementing corrective actions
engaging with insurance companies to resolve claim-related issues
creating and negotiating customized payment plans for customers with outstanding balances
handling pre-collection calls to recover payments from customers who are responsible for out-of-pocket expenses
 Key competencies: 
knowledge of basic billing concepts
data management skills with experience in Excel / Google Sheets
hands-on experience with CRMs such as HubSpot, Salesforce or Pipedrive
 excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written – mandatory 
 Nice to have: 
knowledge of the United States medical insurance industry
minimum 1 year of customer service experience in a contact center
 Personality traits: 
very good attention to detail
excellent communication and interpersonal skills
eager for continuous learning, actively seeking out opportunities to acquire new skills
demonstrates curiosity and creativity, approaching problem-solving with an innovative mindset
logical thinker with strong analytical skills
positive and solution-oriented mindset
flexible and adaptable, able to thrive in a fast-paced work environment
 What we offer: 
private medical insurance
professional development opportunities
team building events
young and dynamic team – we celebrate diversity and believe in the power of different voices coming together to drive innovation
